title: Run a bounded-retry Agentic Recipe with visible escalation
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. He loads Agentic Recipe `bounded_retry` with three fixture attempts that succeed on the last try, runs `run_recipe`, and verifies attempt_count, success without escalation, and the repeating attempt stop contract. Must compose with durable external-effect recovery from TDR crash-window stories. [^rc-bounded-retry]
implementation: Agentic Recipe `bounded_retry` via `BoundedRetryTemplate` / `bounded_retry_runner` and product verb `run_recipe` (`BoundedRetryRecipeAdapter`).
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `bounded_retry_recipe.yaml` drives `run_recipe`; expects attempt_count / attempt_succeeded / escalated plus shape keys.
